## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
All quality, model-agreement, and reference-neighbor signals support Normal tissue with 0% invasive risk (tier 4, unflagged) [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Normal 100%, Benign 0%, InSitu 0%, Invasive 0% | Single-class certainty, zero invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {Normal} at 10% alpha (90% test coverage) | Single class at 90% guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 26th percentile OOD, 12/12 regions [F6] | Typical in-distribution image, unflagged |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (89–94% similarity) [F5] | Unanimous reference neighbor match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 2, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score, strongest anti-invasive driver, 0/20 spot check [F2] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 4, 7, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score pushing strongly away from invasion (20/20 check) [F3] · Validated
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 7) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score arguing against stromal invasion (19/20 check) [F4] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 5) · ↑ invasive · Low score creates a small positive offset (12/20 check) · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to the classifier; removing top-risk regions drops invasive probability more than random removal (95% CI excludes zero).
- **Concepts**: Unverified by deletion test (95% CI includes zero), and top driver normal_lobules is Unreliable (0/20 AI spot check).

## Could be wrong if
- Subtle Benign lesions mimic Normal; Benign contrast case BACH_0369 (81% similarity) differs in duct_confined and Unreliable mitoses.
- Focal atypia is missed; HoVer-Net flagged insufficient tumor nuclei (only 1 neoplastic nucleus in region 7).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 7, 11**: Verify benign stroma and exclude focal atypia where tile risk and 1 neoplastic nucleus peak.
2. **Regions 2, 10, 11**: Confirm normal two-layered lobules directly, because the normal_lobules concept is Unreliable (0/20 spot check).
3. **Regions 5, 9**: Inspect ducts and lymphocytes where tubules, Weak duct_confined, and Unreliable mitoses scores peak.
